title: Get approval to trade on council land or roads
what: Get the council's approval before selling goods, services, food or drink for profit on council-controlled land or a state-controlled road. Trading on a council road next to the business's own premises needs no approval if it meets set standards, including $10 million public liability insurance.

laws.title: Toowoomba Regional Council Subordinate Local Law No. 1.2 (Commercial Use of Local Government Controlled Areas and Roads) 2020

sources.title: Toowoomba Regional Council Subordinate Local Law No. 1.2 (Commercial Use of Local Government Controlled Areas and Roads) 2020
sources.quote: commercial use of local government controlled areas and roads means the use of a local government controlled area or road for soliciting or carrying on the supply of goods and services (including food or drink) for profit

sources.title: Toowoomba Regional Council Subordinate Local Law No. 1.2 (Commercial Use of Local Government Controlled Areas and Roads) 2020
sources.quote: An approval is not required under the authorising local law for the prescribed activity if—
